mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the risk-free rate, which raises the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns (conditional on FEDFUNDS>5.0) is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The real interest rate (computed as FEDFUNDS minus CPIAUCSL) is negatively related to S&P 500 returns. When the real rate is high (i.e., FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL), it compresses equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the labor market is tight, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns (conditional on UNRATE<4.5) is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 370000, it signals strong housing demand, which supports equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day returns (conditional on RSAFS>370000) is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as it increases the discount rate applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
